status.label: Tracked by the simultaneous-modifier feature request
status.detail: The requested support for using left and right Shift together was moved by the reporter into open feature request #39238; this issue does not describe a separate defect.

judgment.rationale: The issue asks Keyboard Manager to support shortcuts that require both Shift (Left) and Shift (Right) simultaneously. The discussion determined this is currently unsupported functionality, not a bug in an advertised behavior, and the reporter opened #39238 specifically as the feature request for allowing both sides of the same modifier. #39238 remains open and describes this issue as its predecessor, so it is the active tracker; no competing bug fix should be created for #37616.
evidence: The report asks for a new shortcut capability: use both Shift (Left) and Shift (Right) simultaneously.

A contributor explained that Keyboard Manager's current shortcut representation does not support assigning multiple Shift modifiers; the conversation then redirected the request to a feature proposal.
The reporter explicitly opened #39238 as the feature request for allowing both left and right Shift in one shortcut.
Open #39238 repeats the requested behavior and links back to #37616 as the preceding bug report.
The issue has seven comments, no assignees, and remains open.
judgment.recommended_action: Keep the requested functionality tracked in #39238 and avoid duplicating it as a bug fix under #37616.

fix_assessment.rationale: This is an unsupported feature request now tracked by open #39238, not an independently actionable defect.
